variants.hypothesis: Baseline: the agent's unaided behaviour with no skill installed.
Modern agents need only the essentials: matches principled on pass within noise at fewer tokens; refuted if principled beats it beyond noise.
variants.form: terse rules, no rationale, about 60 lines

variants.hypothesis: Explaining why improves judgement: beats control on pass, especially maintain/audit bad_claims.
variants.form: every core principle with its reason (skill-creator style)

variants.hypothesis: An explicit final scan of the diff raises maintain/audit pass rates over principled; refuted if it adds noise_lines without a bad_claims gain.
variants.form: principled content as an edit-time workflow: read comments as claims before editing, note evidence while editing, then a hunk-by-hunk and repo-wide diff scan before finishing; short separate path for comment-only requests

variants.hypothesis: Concrete contrasts calibrate restraint and specificity: lower noise_lines on restrain and higher recall on capture than principled.
variants.form: principled SKILL.md plus a 3-line pointer to references/examples.md (17 contrasting bad/good comment pairs across four duties, loaded on demand)

variants.hypothesis: Writing for a weaker reader raises capture recall but fails restrain budgets more often; the proxy shows the cost, the benefit (if any) needs #19.
variants.form: same as principled plus a stance section explaining the newcomer reader
